composition_subtypes.role: compute non-decreasing run lengths per column

payload.core_composition_summary: Preprocess each column with 1D DP to compute depth, then max per row; queries answered by comparing max depth to interval length.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a simple 1D DP to preprocess lengths of non-decreasing segments in each column, then takes row-wise max. No other algorithmic families are integrated.
